text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, Admire 
Groove paused in front of a cafe.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ......This is...
choice_data_list: A board game cafe, huh—are you curious?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...No. It's just, the puzzle on display—

Ho! Color me surprised. To think you knew 
of that work!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's a hidden gem among board game 
enthusiasts... Heh, you've got a keen eye.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...It's just a coincidence. We just used 
to hang out long ago."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Putting it together over and over within 
the time limit... I was only one step 
away, yet couldn't reach completion—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Such meticulously calculated 
design! Though it lacks elements of mind 
games or competition, its depth is truly 
formidable.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, really... The creator of this game 
deserves nothing but praise.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...The author.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Did you know? He used to be a 
programmer at a video game company. That 
experience really shines through in this 
work tooâ

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —I'm not interested.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Huh... What!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know who made it. ...Nor do I 
care to know."

"Her reaction was almost one of pure 
rejection. ...Come to think of it, I 
recall something similar happening 
before."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
An urgent visit to Japan... So they're 
"touching down" in Japan, huh. Sounds like 
they'll be performing a "melody" live.
choice_data_list:
'Since we have the chance, wanna go check 
it out?'

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —No, I refuse.

Even back then, she refused to watch the 
band, saying, "Just the audio track is 
enough, I don't care about the rest."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~... Did I just step on a landmine...? 
No, but seriously, that's way too 
unforgiving for a first-timer, right? 
There's no way anyone could know that...
choice_data_list: C-Come to think of it, why are you here?
C-Come to think of it, why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem*! Heh... I heard they're demoing 
the new title from the creator of this 
puzzle game.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...A new release...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oops, you didn't know? I thought that was 
the reason for you guys, too.

However, stepping foot into the board game 
café...

text_block_list.name: Game Designer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for coming today. ...Ahaha, I don't 
get opportunities like this very often, so 
I feel a little shy.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that was... quite a surprise. I never 
thought the author would actually be there 
in person.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's a chance to promote the new release, 
after all. I suppose it's meant to serve 
as a fan interaction event too.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Um, it's an honor to meet you...! I've 
loved your work ever since I was a little 
kid!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. If you have business with me, 
let's make it quick.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Oh... Aren't you going to speak to them? 
Even though the author themselves is right 
over there?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —It has nothing to do with me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"All I need is the work itself. I don't 
need other people—not even the author."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Something that has no place in my 
world.

...Strangely enough, it looked as though 
she was saying those words just to 
convince herself.

Rejecting others with desperate resolve. 
It felt as though she possessed a will 
like that—

The Umamusume known as Admire Groove never 
shows her true heart to others.

Endlessly strong, endlessly noble. She 
strives to remain solitary and proud. 
...Which is precisely why—

Could it be that she's refusing to connect 
with anyone through her creations...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Hm, I see.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you don't have to talk to them. 
After all, some people aren't interested 
in the author.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, one could call it pure. 
You're simply enjoying the work itself, 
after all."
choice_data_list:
Could it be that you're surprisingly fond 
of board games...?

Does that mean you're more comfortable 
being alone?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: No, not at all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"You always give me the cold shoulder when 
I invite you. Though I'd really love to 
test my skills against yours."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Your calm, intellectual playstyle... I 
look forward to relishing it to the 
fullest.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...No, I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You are welcome to interpret it that 
way.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hoh. ...I can understand how you feel, 
actually.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Cooped up in my room, playing online board 
games all by myself. ...Sometimes, I'm 
just in that kind of mood.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.
